724:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

724:t_1:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「...In the end, even $$サクリファイ$$ was just like the other $$御使い$$s...」

724:t_1:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「And they were what became of Earth's people in a parallel world.」

724:t_1:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「So they were the reason events in space were calculated in units of Earth's calendar...」

724:t_1:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What truth?! How the hell did those bastards ever accept anyone and walk beside them?!」

724:t_1:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「But reaching the truth must have opened the path to $$シンカ$$ and made them higher-dimensional life-forms.」

724:t_1:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The coexistence they achieved was probably a fusion of minds... or, one might say, of lives.」

724:t_1:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サクリファイ$$ said all the people of Earth ascended into the four $$御使い$$s...」

724:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「She likely meant that every human life became one, then separated into four beings representing the basic human emotions: joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure.」

724:t_1:13.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「So they're beings formed by the fusion of countless lives...」

724:t_1:14.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$ tried to accomplish that through the power of a system.」

724:t_1:15.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「The people of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ did the same.」

724:t_1:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We should assume such attempts were made in various forms across many worlds.」

724:t_1:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Was what $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ tried to do another such attempt...?)

724:t_1:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Some life-forms in space, like the $$バジュラ$$ and $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, have existed as collective organisms from the beginning.」

724:t_1:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s... in other words, this universe's people of Earth, probably chose that form of coexistence and were reborn as higher-dimensional life-forms.」

724:t_1:20.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Still, the people of this world's Earth must've all been pretty damn full of themselves.」

724:t_1:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah. Every last one of the $$御使い$$s completely looks down on other humans.」

724:t_1:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...In a sense, that may be understandable.」

724:t_1:23.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're saying you approve of the $$御使い$$s...?!」

724:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We do not know what the people of Earth were like before becoming $$御使い$$s. But the fact remains that the $$御使い$$s are transcendent beings.」

724:t_1:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To them, humanity, still evolving, is insignificant... One could say arrogance was an inevitable result.」

724:t_1:26.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$ゼロ$$... Are those words drawn from your own experience, with your $$ギアス$$ and brilliant strategic mind?」

724:t_1:27.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean by that, $$シリウス$$?!」

724:t_1:28.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I intend no snide remark or sarcasm. I ask purely out of interest.」

724:t_1:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is all right, $$カレン$$. Speaking openly with one another is important.」

724:t_1:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Besides, $$シリウス$$... Is that not also a question about yourself, born into royalty and possessing an $$エレメント$$'s power?」

724:t_1:31.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Heh... You saw right through me.」

724:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I will give you my view.」

724:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A teacher looking at students... no, a parent looking at a young child naturally sees them as immature, and sometimes behaves like a god.」

724:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To the child, that can sometimes be unforgivable arrogance and something to fear.」

724:t_1:35.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So since the $$御使い$$s are the same way, you're saying we just have to put up with them...?!」

724:t_1:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Being a parent gives one no right to rob a child of their fate.」

724:t_1:38.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I agree with $$ゼロ$$. No matter what power someone possesses, they have no right to do as they please with another person's life.」

724:t_1:39.en:
$$シリウス$$
「And it is even less acceptable when they force their goodwill on others.」

724:t_1:40.en:
$$キリコ$$
「No life has to obey anyone... That's all there is to it.」

724:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s did unite the wills of all Earth's people and were reborn as higher-dimensional life-forms. That could be called a form of coexistence.」

724:t_1:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But the truth should not be confined to a single planet or a single species.」

724:t_1:43.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Yes. It should be what allows life to spread throughout this vast, boundless universe.」

724:t_1:44.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So if we're gonna get along, we should do it with the whole universe, not just our own people.」

724:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s cannot understand that. One could therefore call them an obstacle to the universe's truth.」

724:t_1:46.en:
$$カレン$$
「We have no choice but to fight...」

724:t_1:47.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We have to fight to live.」

724:t_1:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I hear Dr. $$トライア$$ and her colleagues have located the solar system and Earth within this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

724:t_1:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They have also learned something about this universe's unusual nature.」

724:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Apparently, this universe is connected to every parallel world.」

724:t_1:52.en:
$$シリウス$$
「So it is like the $$天柱$$, which passes through the Milky Way in every parallel world.」

724:t_1:53.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As expected of a universe inhabited by self-proclaimed overseers. They probably reshaped their universe to interfere with other worlds.」

724:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They also confirmed that distortions in each parallel universe are progressing at an accelerating rate.」

724:t_1:56.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「The universe's great collapse really wasn't over...?!」

724:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That would seem to be the case.」

724:t_1:58.en:
$$カレン$$
「We should've sent the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest into the gap between dimensions. Is it still out there somewhere...?」

724:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$御使い$$s probably know the truth of it.」

724:t_1:60.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then we'll just barge in there and get some answers already.」

724:t_1:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$エス・テラン$$... The planet of the gods... Is that where everything will be decided...?」

724:t_2:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sorry... I'm sorry, 《$$浜本$$》... I couldn't do anything...」

724:t_2:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Dad... I... I might... put the company out of business...」

724:t_2:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Father... Why did you die and leave me behind...?」

724:t_2:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$バーコフ$$, $$ゴダン$$, $$コチャック$$, $$ザキ$$... They all... died...」

724:t_2:7.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm sorry, $$ティナ$$... And $$ミムジィ$$... Will I... never see you again...?」

724:t_2:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stay away, $$ジェリド$$...! I'm... not a murderer...!」

724:t_2:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times... do I have to kill that girl and that puppy...?」

724:t_2:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「We are the world's enemies... $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

724:t_2:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't go, $$ティファ$$...! Don't... leave me behind!」

724:t_2:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ディアナ$$... I suppose... this really is goodbye...」

724:t_2:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$...! You're... the $$ザビ家$$'s...」

724:t_2:18.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Papa... 《$$スミス$$》...! $$キミコ$$... $$ユング#pilot$$, everyone...!」

724:t_2:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! I'm... not your Big Sis!」

724:t_2:20.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Why...?! Why won't you listen to my song?!」

724:t_2:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm sorry... I... can't return your feelings...」
